findings.description: The stub lacks any error handling for I2C operations.
There is no guarantee the I2C bus is opened, configured for the correct slave address, or that the I2C peripheral is ready before use.
While value is uint16_t, the AD5693 family has variants with different resolutions.
If multiple threads call writeDAC concurrently on the same I2C bus/device without synchronization, messages can interleave and corrupt transfers.
The device expects a specific byte order and command format.
I2C operations may block on a busy or wedged bus.
Encoding command fields ad-hoc increases risk of mistakes and future errors.
